references.title: Live camera with PTZ joystick controls
references.take: Live camera interface with on-screen joystick for pan/tilt controls and directional buttons, plus flash and honk toggle options.

references.title: Security camera demo
references.take: Multi-camera view with transform and motion-sensor icons for each room camera; status indicator shows camera arm/disarm state.

references.title: Switching stream views
references.take: 5-screen flow: recording interface with participant grid thumbnail strip on left sidebar, then switching to fullscreen single participant view with gallery and speaker modes; shows view toggle pattern.

references.title: Adding a security device
references.take: Security camera setup onboarding with pairing flow, LED status check, setup code entry, and motion/contact sensor configuration.
